notes: Positions only — MediaPipe hand landmarks carry no per-joint orientation, so observation.hand.<side>.rot is never filled for this layout. The palm chain (wrist→index_mcp→middle_mcp→ring_mcp→pinky_mcp) follows MediaPipe HAND_CONNECTIONS; the extra closing edge (wrist, pinky_mcp) is dropped so parents forms a tree. Producers using MediaPipe *world* landmarks with a head-anchored placement MUST declare observation.hand.frame = head_anchored: the pose is metric and self-consistent within the hand, but absolute depth is not recovered.
